'''Coil-Cell Needlers''' were a variety of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TORAT:S" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as "Lefty" [[Grandarak]] owned a [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] of this make, although he was willing to give it away to an upcoming young [[Voidhound|smuggler]]. The pistols were [[Color/Legends|bronze]] in color and could be sold for 105 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Parts of the pistol were modifiable, including its [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] and [[Crystal/Legends|color crystal]].<ref name="TORAT:S" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coil-Cell Needlers first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game, the blasters are only usable by members of the smuggler class, who are given them as a reward for the quest "Advanced Training: Smuggler," provided they choose the [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]] advanced class. The quest can be completed by talking to Grandarak either on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] or while on [[Carrick Station]]. This article makes no assumption about where the quest is completed or what advanced class is chosen.
